report.explanation: All checkout observations returned 200 with durations 62-344ms; logs show no errors and metrics show zero 502s. The 344ms first request is a cold-start outlier, not a sustained fault. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause (no 5xx, no pool exhaustion, no redis timeout, no memory growth, no deployment facts). Insufficient evidence to name a bounded root cause; handing off.
missing_evidence: Sustained latency or error evidence beyond a single 344ms cold-start sample
Dependency-level latency/error metrics for order, inventory, payment, redis, postgres
Deployment or configuration change records correlated with the alert window
Memory retention trend across multiple windows to assess leak
